items.notes: Anti-corruption adapter page is scoped to semantic translation and safe coexistence between legacy and new domains; unowned mapping risk is its core subject.
Page covers keep/modularize/extract decisions, not local read models or strong-consistency synchronous dependencies.
Effect identity is relevant to lost acknowledgments and deduplication, but the page owns contract/effect semantics, not job-status recovery.
Excerpt states Envoy fetches endpoints from an xDS management server via EDS, which is the required infrastructure.
Excerpt requires a known count or an explicit release/expiry rule so partial results are observable instead of silently succeeding.
Claim Check page directly covers publishing a token separately from payload and the need to own payload lifecycle and failure handling.
Outbox publication and ordering page owns what the relay must do between commit and publication.
Outbox publication and ordering page directly covers duplicate publication and consumer tolerance after relay failure.
Caching correctness and invalidation page directly addresses the limits of expiration for keeping cached values fresh.
Cache invalidation page directly covers write-triggered invalidation and its dependence on reliable change signals.
